requirements.gap: Need complete historical swaps with contract addresses, stable event keys and causal USD notionals; separate economic purchases from pool hops and aggregator duplicates.
Need historical verified ERC20 USDC/WETH-pair membership, decimals/type provenance and disappeared tokens, not current popular pools.
Need comparable historical gas, ETH/USD and explicit allowance/transaction-cost assumptions, not zero gas or the copied wallet receipt blindly.
Need amount/route-aware next-block entry and 24h exit at historical state, fees, impact, sellability and observation timing; historical swaps or current Quoter do not prove these.

Frozen plan does not by itself resolve router, smart-wallet and economic-owner attribution or DEX coverage. Do not silently substitute tx_from or restrict the universe to one DEX. Define semantics before any outcome inspection.
Need canonical block/hash, transaction/log order, removed-log rejection and honest availability assumptions. Dataset ingestion today is not historical observation latency.
Keyed/free and public/anonymous are distinct. No credentials, project creation, paid queries or source data retrieval occurred.

reentry_condition: New complete permissible historical bundle or separately authorized keyed access; certify normalization and historical execution before a visible evaluation. Do not repeat unchanged documentation searches.
